image.description: A photo with the alt text that describes it.

alt.description: Describes the photo for people who can't see it.

cityRef.description: A record in the city's own systems that this refers to, such as a work order in an open data portal. Matching is the author's claim, not the city's.

system.description: Where the record lives, e.g. socrata:data.norfolk.gov/qzfe-wj25.

id.description: The record's identifier in that system.

url.description: A page where anyone can see the record.

money.description: An amount of money as an estimate or an asking price. It never moves money.

amount.description: In the currency's minor unit, e.g. cents.
